definitions.explanation: Italian-style frozen dessert, denser and less fatty than ordinary ice cream. In Japan it is strongly associated with tourist areas and with shops selling flavors made from local produce.

examples.japanese: ジェラートを{二種類|にしゅるい}{選|えら}んだ。
examples.english: I chose two flavors of gelato.

examples.japanese: この{牧場|ぼくじょう}のジェラートは{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}の{味|あじ}が{濃|こ}い。
examples.english: The gelato at this dairy farm has a rich milk flavor.

examples.japanese: {旅先|たびさき}で、その{土地|とち}の{果物|くだもの}を{使|つか}ったジェラートを{食|た}べるのが{楽|たの}しみだ。
examples.english: When traveling, I look forward to eating gelato made with the local fruit.

notes:
Ordered by flavor count — シングル (one scoop) or ダブル (two scoops).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ジェラートを{食|た}べる: to eat gelato
- ジェラート{屋|や}さん: a gelato shop
- {季節|きせつ}{限定|げんてい}のジェラート: seasonal gelato flavors
- ダブルのジェラート: a double scoop of gelato

SIMILAR WORDS:
- アイスクリーム: ice cream — the general word; gelato is presented as the artisanal Italian version
- ソフトクリーム: soft serve — dispensed from a machine into a cone
- シャーベット: sorbet — made without milk
